rumour_meeting: Since you gave him the guard, Varen has been smiling a lot.
conspiracy_ripens: You let the rumour about the chapel go. The chapel did not let you go.
the_coup: You were told about the chapel. You chose not to look.
watchers_found: You paid to learn that he was innocent.
kovane_doubt: Varen's clerks came the week you gave him the guard.
kovane_returns: You sent him away. The city spent that time learning his name.
dorne_alliance: She has not forgotten your toast. She enjoyed it, which is worse.
dorne_price: You backed her plan. She kept the receipt.
leverage_use: The letter is still in your sleeve.
pamphlet_storm: You backed the whole plan. Someone is making sure everyone hears about it.
You tried the plan in one province. The rest of the kingdom is impatient.
anselm_arrest: You banned the leaflets. The handwritten copies are better.
vask_collect: The soldiers were paid on time, thanks to him.
guild_strike: Salt costs more this month, and everyone knows who signed for it.
You paid him back in full. He took it as goodbye.
vask_confrontation: The trail led exactly where you were afraid it would.
ysolde_ledger: You have lost count of the favours. She has not.
tasting_cup: Aubry gave you a small bottle for exactly this.
You told the whole council. The poisoner heard it first.
veiled_meeting: You burned the note. She does not seem to mind.
veiled_price: The doors she opened are still open. You never asked what they cost.
sabel_treaty: The star finder is on your desk. It is never far from your mind.
sabel_betrayal: You signed before dawn, as he asked.
friend_betrays: You gave him a job because he was your friend.
rask_wavers: You gave him the Western Keys. He has not forgotten that, or what else he might be given.
retire_offer: They still say please. The window is closing.
king_death: You made a promise in the shadow of the church. Someone is listening for it.
coalition_moves: Everyone you used has compared notes.
final_session: You brought a plot to light. They remember who held the lamp.
